title: CRISPR-UMI Step by Step: A protocol for robust CRISPR screening
protocol: Design vector backbone containing ampicillin resistance for amplification in bacteria.
Include viral packaging sequence Psi and long terminal repeats (LTRs) for retrovirus generation.
Integrate sgRNA cassette with U6 promoter and cloning site for CRISPR guides.
Add improved CRISPR-Scaffold as described previously.
Incorporate PGK NeoR for selection purposes.
Clone P5 and P7 Illumina adaptor sequences into the vector backbone.
Integrate random sequences termed barcodes for unique molecular identifiers (UMIs).
Include illumina i7 primer binding site for barcode sequencing.
Design PCR product from illumina P5 Adaptor to illumina P7 adaptor for direct next generation sequencing on an Illumina HiSeq2500 sequencer using dual indexing.
Read custom primer for "read 1" to obtain CRISPR-guide sequence.
Use "index1-read" to determine barcode sequence.
Utilize "index2-read" for experimental index differentiation between samples.
Flank PCR-Amplicon with Pac-I restriction sites for cassette enrichment from genomic DNA.
Clone random nucleotides of length 10 bp downstream of Illumina's i7 primer binding site and P7 adaptor into the vector backbone.
Ensure cloning complexity is at least 1 million but aim for higher complexities.
Select guide RNAs targeting mouse nuclear genes and drug orthologues.
Choose a set of hand-selected genes, with 4 sgRNAs per gene for non-drugged genes and 5 sgRNAs per gene for drugged genes.
Design a guide selection algorithm considering both guide efficiency and biological effect due to gene structure.
Calculate activity scores based on the Doench et al. method for all potential sgRNAs.
Exclude incompatible sgRNAs that contain specific sequences or start/end with certain motifs.
Penalize Doench scores based on heuristic rules to select sgRNAs likely to cause loss-of-function phenotypes.
Consider exon properties such as protein domains, exon size, and multiple of 3bp rule for penalizing Doench scores.
Create penalties for exon distribution to spread sgRNAs over many exons, with no penalty for the best-scoring sgRNA per exon.
Avoid selecting sgRNAs that are less than 4nt away from another better scoring sgRNA.
Clone sgRNAs PCR amplified from chip-oligo synthesis into a vector backbone containing UMIs.
Generate virus in Plat-E cells for packaging.
Infect at least six 150mm dishes with the generated virus to retain complexity and even representation of guide-barcode pairs.
Grow cells from 30 million to 300 million.
Split cells every second day in a ratio of 1:10, keeping at least 30 million cells and discarding the rest.
Before and during gene-editing, introduce a strong dilution step after mutations are set to ensure only one daughter cell remains.
Expand the population again after the dilution step.
Ensure each "grand-daughter" cell carries the same CRISPR mutation.
Most UMIs will be lost during the dilution-expansion process.
Use samtools, fastx-toolkit, and bowtie to map sequencing reads to guides and experiments.
Convert the bamfile from Illumina sequencing into a tab-separated text file.
Include columns for Guidename, Samplename, Barcode, Sequence, Read count in the output file.
Prepare this tab-separated text file as input for further specialized analysis scripts.
Read sequence counts for the conventional approach.
Sum sequence read counts for the same guide and sample but different BC sequences.
Generate a file with columns for Guidename, Genename, ctr (reads), exp (reads).
Use the generated file as input for MAGeCK.
Calculate depletion by RPM(ctr)/RPM(treated) using CRISPR-UMI analysis.
Determine median depletion of clones for each guide in CRISPR-UMI analysis.
Generate a file with median depletions for all guides from CRISPR-UMI analysis.
Generate a MAGeCK analysis input file with columns UMI-name, Guidename, ctr(reads), exp(reads).
Run MAGeCK on the generated file to rank guides by robust ranking algorithm.
Combine median depletion of every guide with MAGeCK neg score.
Rank guides by median depletion and calculate rank/(total number of guides).
Rank guides by MAGeCK neg score and calculate rank/(total number of guides).
Multiply the two calculated values for each guide to obtain a score.
Use Fisher’s method to combine scores for every guide.
Generate a depletion score for each gene based on combined scores.
Plot all guides in a volcano plot to evaluate signal-to-noise ratio.
Define signal as distance from the origin in the volcano plot.
Define noise as the standard deviation among non-targeting control guides.
Rank all guides according to their performance or effect.
Calculate how many guides per gene are found among the top 5 guides.
Calculate how many guides per gene are found among the top 10 guides.
Calculate how many guides per gene are found among the top 20 guides.
Calculate how many guides per gene are found among the top 30 guides.
